✓ History of Spain.fact: In 1981 the 23-F coup d'état attempt took place. Officially, the coup d'état failed thanks to the intervention of King Juan Carlos I.  Spain joined NATO before Calvo-Sotelo left office.  Along with political change came radical change in Spanish society.  Spanish society had been extremely conservative under Franco, but the transition to democracy also began a liberalization of values and social customs.
